setup_batch_predict_server: setup a Ray Serve BatchPredictServer deployment with an MLIPPredictUnit for batched molecular inference
BatchPredictServer_predict: run batched predictions on a list of AtomicData objects with automatic OOM batch splitting
BatchPredictServer_configure_batching: configure the max batch size and wait timeout for the BatchPredictServer deployment
BatchPredictServer_split_predictions: split batched prediction tensors back into individual per-system prediction dictionaries
BatchPredictServer_get_predict_unit_attr: get an attribute from the underlying MLIPPredictUnit by name
